Input preprocessing
Implemented configuration
Projection residual
Stored 30-dimensional fingerprints, without feature standardization

For each retained nonzero template, fit an unconstrained scalar coefficient and minimize the Euclidean residual; the implementation floors the squared-norm denominator at 10⁻¹⁸ and assigns infinite residuals to zero-norm templates.
Cosine 1-NN
Stored 30-dimensional fingerprints, without feature standardization
Select the retained template with maximum cosine similarity; candidate norms ≤ 10⁻¹² are excluded.
Cosine k-NN
No feature standardization
KNeighborsClassifier; k = 5; cosine distance; uniform neighbour voting.
Random Forest
No feature standardization
100 trees; Gini criterion; bootstrap sampling; max_features = sqrt; no maximum depth; min_samples_split = 2; min_samples_leaf = 1; random_state = run seed.
SVM (RBF)
StandardScaler fitted to the retained pool
SVC; RBF kernel; C = 1; gamma = scale; tolerance = 0.001; probability estimation disabled.
MLP
StandardScaler fitted to the retained pool

Hidden layers 128 and 64; ReLU; Adam; initial learning rate 0.001; alpha = 0.0001; batch_size = auto; at most 400 iterations; early_stopping = True; validation_fraction = 0.1; n_iter_no_change = 10; tolerance = 0.0001; random_state = run seed.
Nearest Centroid
StandardScaler fitted to the retained pool
Euclidean distance; uniform class priors; no centroid shrinkage.
Logistic Regression
StandardScaler fitted to the retained pool
lbfgs solver; C = 1; L2 penalty; intercept fitted; max_iter = 1000; tolerance = 0.0001; random_state = run seed.
GCN+
Raw scalar pressure change per sensor; no input StandardScaler
Three GCNConv layers of width 128; shared sensor-identity stem and raw-fingerprint readout described below.
GAT+
Raw scalar pressure change per sensor; no input StandardScaler
Three GATConv layers; the first two use four heads with 32 channels per head, and the final layer uses one 128-channel head with concat = False; attention dropout 0.3.
GraphSAGE+
Raw scalar pressure change per sensor; no input StandardScaler
Three SAGEConv layers of width 128, using the default mean neighbourhood aggregation; shared stem and readout described below.
